goal: WTAgent model-driven development and local Windows verification
note: Planning manifest only. No autonomous executor consumes this file yet. GitHub Issues are disabled in this repository.

tasks.title: Durable XML and tool-result reconciliation
tasks.outcome: Successful multi-round tool calls with exactly-once assistant/tool result handling.
acceptance: Correlate every model outbound and tool result to durable IDs and acknowledgements
Test malformed/truncated XML, duplicate callbacks, lost IPC, restart during tool result
No blind replay after ambiguous outbound commit
Real Windows smoke: repeated multistep tool sequence

tasks.title: Long-run reliability measurement
tasks.outcome: Reproducible tool-loop success, failure, and recovery metrics.
acceptance: Record exact candidate SHA and actual test counts
Run a native browser smoke only on explicitly approved test account/environment
Report timeouts, stop/retry reasons and all skipped checks
Failures preserve durable checkpoints

tasks.title: Default CLI Supervisor Worker integration
acceptance: Default CLI uses Supervisor and Worker
--legacy remains a diagnostic fallback
Worker smoke completes a simple XML response
tasks.evidence: User reported a successful native Windows Supervisor/Worker model.message_complete and run.completed on 2026-10-31. This is smoke evidence, not a full reliability certificate.

tasks.title: Watch trusted PR SHAs and return GitHub verification summaries
tasks.outcome: Local verifier monitors approved PR changes and reports once per candidate SHA.
acceptance: No untrusted fork or unapproved author candidate executes
One candidate SHA is verified once across process restarts
SHA changes trigger revalidation and mismatches fail closed
Sanitized WT_VERIFY_V1 feedback does not include raw logs
Never auto-merge, install, or publish

tasks.title: Consume PR feedback and wake authorized developer model
tasks.outcome: After a failed verified PR revision, an external agent reads feedback and prepares a bounded fix without user copy/paste.
acceptance: Consume only verified PR SHA and trusted feedback
Review failed tests without assuming success
Produce a fix commit/PR or explicit BLOCKED state
Enforce loop and token budgets; stop at permission boundaries

tasks.title: Task DAG and acceptance checkpoint contract
tasks.outcome: High-level goal is decomposed into durable subtasks with objective completion gates.
acceptance: Structured goals, tasks, prerequisites, proof, budgets and stop reasons
At least three dependent subtasks with explicit artifact acceptance
Resuming a killed agent skips previously verified steps
Failure cannot be marked done without evidence

tasks.title: Safe context rotation at clean handoff
tasks.outcome: Long tasks move to a fresh model conversation from a compact durable state.
acceptance: Never rotate with pending outbound, assistant, auxiliary, or tool acknowledgement
Preserve exact artifact and verified step references
Avoid duplicate messages/tools after restart

tasks.title: Self-repair with last-known-good runtime and approvals
tasks.outcome: Agent can diagnose and propose fix PRs while reliable verifier remains separate.
acceptance: Intentionally broken candidates are rejected before deployment
Rollback uses exact approved revision
No automatic global install, publish or merge
Explicit notification and approval for production changes
